author: Inside Edition
description: Inside the largest Cathedral in North America is the unlikely home to one of the final works of legendary artist Keith Haring. In the final weeks of his life, he created the “Life of Christ” triptych. After his death from AIDS, the piece was donated by Yoko Ono to the Cathedral of St. John the Divine.  The piece was made from clay and then cast in bronze and white gold, weighing over 600 pounds. There are three original pieces that were donated to churches that were important to Haring--  in San Francisco, Paris, and New York. The Cathedral's Dean Winnie Varghese speaks to Inside Edition Digital about how the artwork came to be and what it means.
title: This NYC Cathedral Has One of the Final Keith Haring Artworks
